scope: Read-only Python diagnostic helper process; not a verifier/probe run.

api_provenance.abi: ctypes declared uint32 count/index, pointer header/name, bool result, uint8[16] UUID; no private struct layout interpretation.

limitations: LC_UUID and shared cache UUID identify observed installed images; they do not prove source correspondence, byte identity, or allocation coverage.
The Apple immutable source URL supports API declaration provenance only; the installed OS build need not correspond to that source revision.
The helper loaded system image set is not the future diagnostic verifier image set. Actual probe must identify its own loaded images.
dyld_info output can list multiple cached variants; only loaded_system_images records the image selected in this helper.
No process addresses, thread identifiers, or unrelated process state were retained.
